title: SQUARE-ROOT COVARIANCE QUALIFICATION AND K_SRP FORMAL-UNCERTAINTY REPAIR

oracle.rationale: every IEEE-754 double is a dyadic rational, so the normal matrix is exactly representable and the inverse carries zero arithmetic error

method.covariance: QR of the whitened scaled design, P = R^-1 R^-T via two triangular solves; normal matrix never formed
method.prior_handling: prior square-root rows appended to the design
method.prior_sqrt: symmetric eigendecomposition (prior information is routinely only semi-definite; Cholesky would raise)
method.rank_criterion: sigma_i > sigma_max * n * eps on the singular values of R (a pure ratio, hence scale-invariant)
method.rank_failure: RankDeficientCovarianceError raised, never a floor-derived finite covariance
